study_identification_part.si4_title: Social behavior in ASD males: The interplay between cognitive flexibility, working memory, and functional connectivity deviations

answer: ABIDE I and II males (total n = 816; 321 non-ASD training, 77 non-ASD testing, 418 ASD; ages 5.1–14.0 years)
dc1_datasets_using_in_this_study.detail: Male-only subset of ABIDE I/II providing resting-state fMRI and phenotypes; 80% of non-ASD males used for normative training and the remaining non-ASD plus ASD males used for testing/deviation analyses.
dc1_datasets_using_in_this_study.supporting_text: "Data for the current study were from the Autism Brain Imaging Data Exchange (ABIDE) I and ABIDE II collections... only males between ages 5.1 -14.0 years were included in this study (n = 816). The study dataset was then split into training and testing datasets. The training dataset was composed of 80 % of non-ASD males ... testing dataset was composed of the remaining 20 % of non-ASD males and ASD males."

answer.ABIDE non-ASD training set (n=321): Normative model training for between-network rsFC trajectories.
answer.ABIDE testing set (77 non-ASD, 418 ASD): Validation and application set to compute deviation (z) scores and relate them to social behavior.

dc2_purpose_of_each_dataset.detail: Non-ASD males (80%) train generalized additive models; remaining non-ASD and ASD males form the testing cohort for deviation scoring, sparse CCA, and mediation analyses.
dc2_purpose_of_each_dataset.supporting_text: "The training dataset was composed of 80 % of non-ASD males, while the testing dataset was composed of the remaining 20 % of non-ASD males and ASD males." ... "Normative models were then applied to the testing dataset ... deviation scores (z) were then calculated."
